name: iframer-toolkit
description: Browser access toolkit for AI agents — CLI and MCP server for headless/headful browsing, login flows, and pipeline execution.
author: Eduardo Verona

scripts.build:cli: bun build bin/cli.js --target node --format cjs --outfile dist/cli.cjs --external better-sqlite3 --external patchright --external fingerprint-generator --external @anthropic-ai/sdk --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external zod
scripts.build:mcp: bun build src/mcp/server.ts --target node --format cjs --outfile dist/mcp-server.cjs --external better-sqlite3 --external patchright --external fingerprint-generator --external @anthropic-ai/sdk --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external zod
scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:mcp
